description: This file defines the class RuntimeFeatureControlProcessor for managing runtime feature control, including configuration, JSON processing, and telemetry notifications, within an RFC (Remote Feature Control) management system.

classes.name: RuntimeFeatureControlProcessor
classes.description: A class that manages runtime feature control, including initialization, processing requests, JSON handling, and telemetry notifications.

methods.name: InitializeRuntimeFeatureControlProcessor
methods.description: Initializes the runtime feature control processor.

methods.name: ProcessRuntimeFeatureControlReq
methods.description: Processes a runtime feature control request.

methods.name: getRebootRequirement
methods.description: Returns whether a reboot is required.
